fire: The paper was co-written by Maria Aveni and two colleagues from the institute in Ghent.
Local historian Patrick Devenney gave a talk about the town's old linen mills.
Among the guests at the gala were the director Laura Iveson and her husband.
The defence was led by the barrister Thomas Gravenor, who argued for an adjournment.
A review by Grimley Evans and colleagues summarised the trial evidence on dementia.
The cast also includes Brian Avery, Ruth Covenay and Tom Glass in supporting roles.
Senior engineer Kim Stevenson presented the redesign of the cooling system.
Thanks go to the curator, Hanna Ravensdale, for lending the manuscripts.
